sections.title: Health, symptoms, and advice
body: At a clinic, give main symptom, duration, and severity.
For urgent danger, follow local emergency guidance; this lesson cannot assess seriousness.
Follow actual medicine labels and professional advice.

sections.title: Three health patterns
body: Use Jag har ont i + definite body part: huvudet, halsen, ryggen.
Use Jag mår … for general wellbeing and Jag känner mig … for a felt condition.
Advice modals take bare infinitive: måste vila, kan ringa, bör dricka. A lesson cannot diagnose.

assignment.title: Episode 17 mission: Health, symptoms, and advice
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear twice and answer: Which symptom is absent?

READ: Read for purpose and detail. Answer: What should someone do in immediate danger?

SPEAK: Describe two fictional symptoms and duration. Try once unaided, then improve one detail.

WRITE: Cancel an appointment because you are ill and suggest a day. Check word order, forms, and purpose.

TRANSFER: Change the symptom and ask for repetition.

RETURN: Use har ont i, mår, känner mig.
assignment.model:
Speaking: Jag har ont i halsen och känner mig trött. Det började för två dagar sedan.
Writing: Jag är tyvärr sjuk och kan inte komma idag. Kan vi boka en ny tid på fredag?
